text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is time trial day.
The Umamusume are cycling through cheers and groans
over their respective results.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—We did it! I finally set a new personal best!
And it's all thanks to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: "You did great! Keep up the good work!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: Good work. How were the measurement results?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ Prepare to be amazed.
I blew my personal best right out of the water!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well, for someone like me who always aims for the top,
this much is only natural!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: Your daily efforts have really paid off.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Sure, I'm
always perfect, but this time...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just thanks to my own hard work, or rather...
Well..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Anyway! Keep guiding me properly from now on, got it?!
